complaints.title: Overhead Projector Sparking & Burning Smell in Science Lab
complaints.description: The ceiling projector in Science Lab 102 emitted sparks and a strong burning plastic odor during lecture. The projector has been turned off at breaker, but unit requires urgent replacement.
complaints.aiReasoning: Critical risk: Electrical sparking and burning odor detected in laboratory environment. Automatic safety escalation triggered.

statusHistory.note: Assigned to Senior Electrician Sam Walker
Technician on-site with replacement fuse & circuit test

complaints.title: Major Water Pipe Leak Flooding Restroom Floor
complaints.description: The pipe under the second washbasin in Engineering Block A 2nd floor restroom is ruptured and water is pooling across the walkway into the main corridor.
complaints.aiReasoning: Water leak causing pooling hazard and structural runoff risk. Classified as HIGH priority.

statusHistory.note: AI matched water damage severity (92% confidence)

complaints.title: Central Library AC blowing hot air during exam study hours
complaints.description: The central air conditioning on the 3rd floor quiet study zone has been blowing warm humid air for the past 4 hours. The room is overheating.
complaints.aiReasoning: Comfort and study disruption in high-occupancy library zone. Medium urgency.

complaints.title: Hostel 3 Wi-Fi Gateway Offline on Floors 3 & 4
complaints.description: Campus Wi-Fi AP-H3-401 is showing solid red light. Students are unable to access campus portals or submit assignments from their rooms.
complaints.aiReasoning: Impacts academic connectivity for over 60 resident students before assignment deadlines.

statusHistory.note: Elevated to HIGH priority based on cluster impact

complaints.title: Broken Glass Panel on South Stairwell Fire Door
complaints.description: The safety glass insert on the emergency exit door is shattered. Shards are cracked and could fall if door is pushed hard.
complaints.aiReasoning: Emergency exit safety violation and laceration hazard.
complaints.resolutionNote: Installed new tempered safety glass panel and replaced emergency panic push-bar.

statusHistory.note: Area cordoned off and glass cleanup started
New tempered glass installed & safety inspected

complaints.title: Water Cooler Dispenser Making Strange Hum and Not Cooling
complaints.description: The drinking fountain in the Cafeteria annex is dispensing room-temperature water with a loud grinding motor sound.
complaints.aiReasoning: Non-hazardous sanitation and utility issue. Low urgency.

comments.content: Power to circuit breaker B-12 has been isolated. I have requested a replacement projector ballast from the central inventory.

Shutoff valve closed to stop pooling. Sourcing replacement copper fitting from warehouse.
